zone_map_menu.doc: The zone map page (M2-UI-18; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Zone map). Opened from the field menu's Map row. Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3 (field_menu.json's rule). 'legend' is a MenuPage metrics block, as tall as its places (up to max_rows); 'errands' sits gap px under it (its rect's y is where it would sit under a full legend). 'map' holds the schematic's drawing metrics in px at 1080p: POI glyphs (a backing disc of glyph_px radius, strokes glyph_line_px), the highlight ring, the objective marker (a gold diamond ring of objective_px half-diagonal framing its place's glyph, with a ring that swells outward over pulse_sec, held still under reduced motion), the player arrow, the compass, the shore sampling step in metres, the points per drawn circle, and the inset of the drawing inside its framed panel. 'pieces' are the Haluna kit pieces the map draws, each a footprint [x, z, width, depth] in the piece's own frame (metres, measured from the kit's meshes) and a style: building (roof role), structure (wall role). Pieces not listed (plants, windbreaks, gulls, garlands, the sunken ruins in the lagoon) are left off the map. 'near_m' is how close the player must be for a place to read 'you are here'.
